quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Lizard!
quests.question: l
quests.hint: It has one tall, straight line standing alone.
quests.explanation: Well done! Lizard begins with the letter l. 🦎
quests.funFact: Some lizards can detach their tails to escape predators, and it grows back later!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Mountain!
quests.question: m
quests.hint: Look for two little humps side by side, like two small hills.
quests.explanation: That's right! m is the lowercase letter that starts Mountain. ⛰️
quests.funFact: Mount Everest, the tallest mountain, grows about a quarter of an inch every year!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Nut!
quests.question: n
quests.hint: It has one little hump, like a small hill.
quests.explanation: Well done! Nut begins with the letter n. 🥜
quests.funFact: Peanuts aren't actually nuts; they grow underground and are legumes!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Ocean!
quests.question: O
quests.hint: It has a big round circle.
quests.explanation: Well done! Ocean begins with the letter O. 🌊
quests.funFact: We have explored less than 5% of the world's oceans!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Piano!
quests.question: P
quests.hint: Look for a tall straight line with one round bump on top.
quests.explanation: That's right! P is the uppercase letter that starts Piano. 🎹
quests.funFact: A standard piano has exactly 88 keys!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Quarter!
quests.question: Q
quests.hint: It has a big circle with a small tail crossing the bottom.
quests.explanation: Well done! Quarter begins with the letter Q. 🪙
quests.funFact: A US quarter has exactly 119 ridges around its edge!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Rocket!
quests.question: r
quests.hint: It has a short straight line with a small curve at the top.
quests.explanation: Well done! Rocket begins with the letter r. 🚀
quests.funFact: Rockets have to travel at 25,000 miles per hour to escape Earth's gravity!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Star!
quests.question: s
quests.hint: Look for a curvy line that curls one way then the other, like a snake.
quests.explanation: That's right! s is the lowercase letter that starts Star. ⭐
quests.funFact: Some stars you see at night are actually two stars orbiting each other!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Turtle!
quests.question: t
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with a small crossbar near the top.
quests.explanation: Well done! Turtle begins with the letter t. 🐢
quests.funFact: Some turtles can live to be over 100 years old!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Universe!
quests.question: U
quests.hint: It has a curved dip with two straight sides, like a little cup.
quests.explanation: Well done! Universe begins with the letter U. 🌌
quests.funFact: The universe is expanding every second, getting bigger and bigger!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Vampire!
quests.question: V
quests.hint: Look for two slanted lines meeting in a point at the bottom.
quests.explanation: That's right! V is the uppercase letter that starts Vampire. 🧛
quests.funFact: Vampire bats are real, but they mostly just drink the blood of sleeping cows!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Window!
quests.question: W
quests.hint: It has four slanted lines dipping up and down, like two V's together.
quests.explanation: Well done! Window begins with the letter W. 🪟
quests.funFact: Before glass was invented, windows were made of flattened animal horns or paper!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Xiphias!
quests.question: x
quests.hint: It has two short lines crossing in the middle.
quests.explanation: Well done! Xiphias begins with the letter x. 🐟
quests.funFact: Xiphias is the scientific name for a swordfish, which can swim 50 miles per hour!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Yacht!
quests.question: y
quests.hint: Look for two short lines meeting in the middle, with a tail that dips below.
quests.explanation: That's right! y is the lowercase letter that starts Yacht. ⛵
quests.funFact: The word yacht comes from a Dutch word meaning 'hunter'!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Zombie!
quests.question: z
quests.hint: It has a zigzag line -- straight, slanted, then straight again.
quests.explanation: Well done! Zombie begins with the letter z. 🧟
quests.funFact: In nature, there is a real fungus that can turn ants into 'zombie ants'!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Airplane!
quests.question: A
quests.hint: It has two slanted lines meeting at the top, with a short line across the middle.
quests.explanation: Well done! Airplane begins with the letter A. ✈️
quests.funFact: The very first airplane flight lasted only 12 seconds!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Banana!
quests.question: B
quests.hint: Look for a tall straight line with two round bumps stacked on the right.
quests.explanation: That's right! B is the uppercase letter that starts Banana. 🍌
quests.funFact: Bananas are technically classified as berries!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Cloud!
quests.question: C
quests.hint: It has a big curved line, open on the right, like a large moon.
quests.explanation: Well done! Cloud begins with the letter C. ☁️
quests.funFact: A single fluffy cloud can weigh as much as 100 elephants!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Dog!
quests.question: d
quests.hint: This letter starts the word Dog. 🐶
quests.explanation: Great work! You matched the lowercase letter d. 🐶
quests.funFact: A dog's sense of smell is 40 times stronger than a human's!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Elephant!
quests.question: e
quests.hint: It has a small circle with a flat line across the middle.
quests.explanation: Well done! Elephant begins with the letter e. 🐘
quests.funFact: Elephants are the only mammals that can't jump!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Flower!
quests.question: f
quests.hint: This letter starts the word Flower. 🌸
quests.explanation: Great work! You matched the lowercase letter f. 🌸
quests.funFact: Sunflowers track the sun across the sky during the day!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Ghost!
quests.question: G
quests.hint: This letter starts the word Ghost. 👻
quests.explanation: Great work! You matched the uppercase letter G. 👻
quests.funFact: In old stories, ghosts were just a way to explain the wind rattling old houses!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Honey!
quests.question: H
quests.hint: It has two tall straight lines joined by a bridge in the middle.
quests.explanation: Well done! Honey begins with the letter H. 🍯
quests.funFact: Honey never goes bad; you could eat honey from 3,000 years ago!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Iguana!
quests.question: I
quests.hint: This letter starts the word Iguana. 🦎
quests.explanation: Great work! You matched the uppercase letter I. 🦎
quests.funFact: Iguanas have a 'third eye' on top of their heads to detect light and shadows!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Jacket!
quests.question: j
quests.hint: This letter starts the word Jacket. 🧥
quests.explanation: Great work! You matched the lowercase letter j. 🧥
quests.funFact: The first jackets with zippers were made in the 1920s!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Key!
quests.question: k
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with two small legs kicking out.
quests.explanation: Well done! Key begins with the letter k. 🔑
quests.funFact: The oldest known keys were made of wood over 4,000 years ago!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Lighthouse!
quests.question: l
quests.hint: This letter starts the word Lighthouse. 🗼
quests.explanation: Great work! You matched the lowercase letter l. 🗼
quests.funFact: The first lighthouse in the world was built in ancient Egypt!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Mouse!
quests.question: M
quests.hint: This letter starts the word Mouse. 🐭
quests.explanation: Great work! You matched the uppercase letter M. 🐭
quests.funFact: Mice use their whiskers to feel changes in temperature and find their way in the dark!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Nest!
quests.question: N
quests.hint: It has two tall lines joined by a slanted line between them.
quests.explanation: Well done! Nest begins with the letter N. 🪹
quests.funFact: Some birds build their nests using mud, spiderwebs, and even their own saliva!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Orange!
quests.question: O
quests.hint: This letter starts the word Orange. 🍊
quests.explanation: Great work! You matched the uppercase letter O. 🍊
quests.funFact: Oranges are actually a type of modified berry!
